# ADR-3229: AWS logging: Prefer GuardDuty across all regions for account 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Single-region detectors miss elsewhere.

## Decision

Security teams SHOULD prefer GuardDuty across all regions for account 5 (AWS-logging-5) when enabling threat detection.

## Consequences

Findings aggregate to a delegated admin.
